name: Preference-Based Teaching Dimension / Recursive Teaching Dimension
proof: For a finite class, fix a total preference order.  To make the learner select a target $h$, the teacher must supply a teaching set that eliminates every hypothesis preferred to $h$; reversing the order turns these into the teaching sets of a recursive teaching plan.  Conversely, the elimination order of a recursive teaching plan, read in reverse, is a preference order under which the same samples teach their assigned concepts.  Both constructions preserve the maximum sample size, so minimizing gives $\mathrm{PBTD}=\mathrm{RTD}$.
